continuity_scope: Lineage II: Aden's North American NCSoft service launch, 11 August 2021, as specified by the 10 August 2021 official Aden Launch Patch Notes. This is not Lineage (the original title), Lineage II Live, Lineage II Classic, a Korean/Japanese/other regional service, later Aden updates, other Lineage titles, or a cross-title continuity synthesis.
work_or_witnesses: NCSoft Lineage II, Aden Launch Patch Notes, 10 August 2021, announcing North American Aden service opening at 9:00 AM PDT on 11 August
NCSoft Lineage II, Aden New Player Guide, 11 August 2021, early race/class quest-variation and level-20 Dawn of Adventure boundary
coverage_rule: Zero-character audit. The selected official launch notes are a systems/race/class/raid/reward document, not a character or story witness. It does not provide a claim-level profile of any stable named dramatic NPC. The named lore entities Gran Kain, Einhasad, Sayha, and Valakas occur only as creator/worship/dragon or loot-table labels; Core, Orfen, Queen Ant, Zaken, Baium, Antharas, Keber, and Keber's Servant occur only as raid/boss/reward labels. None is elevated to a character record. Player-created characters, clans, pets, generic monsters, and classes are likewise excluded.
omissions: All player-created Lineage II Aden characters, names, gender/race/class selections, transfers, stats, transformations, clans, quests, PvP/reputation, deaths, inventories, raids, and account/server-specific progress.

Every named or generic NPC, god, avatar, monster, boss, raid target, faction, race, class, item, zone, and story event for which the selected official launch notes offer no individual dramatic character profile.

Original Lineage, Lineage II Live and Classic, all later Aden updates, other regional versions/localizations, Lineage M/W/2M and other title continuities, adaptations, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and databases.
uncertainties: The source is a pre-launch patch-note document dated 10 August that says the North American Aden service will open at 9:00 AM PDT the following day. It is a version/service witness, not a frozen launch client, narrative transcript, or cast list.
The notes describe player choice in races/classes and multiple transfer branches; no generated player character is a stable named identity.

The document mixes fantasy-lore labels with gameplay systems (for example gods in race description and named bosses in a reward table). Those mentions are insufficient for claim-level NPC records and may differ across regions/updates.
Lineage II's later content updates can change classes, systems, drops, and character services. This launch audit does not assert their persistence or retroactive continuity.
The source is English NCSoft North American web copy; it does not establish exact title, terminology, or canon wording in other localized/regional services.
evidence_basis: Official NCSoft Lineage II Aden launch and player-guide documentation. The evidence is sufficient to audit a clearly bounded zero-character systems pass, but insufficient to support an individual named dramatic-character record. No fan resource is used.
